description: UrbanLPR is a Dongguan traffic-detection release prepared by the UrbanLPR research team for road travel-time and path-reconstruction studies. The repository describes 20 daily Parquet tables for 1 to 20 March 2023. Each detection has a timestamp, an intersection identifier, a vehicle type and a vehicle identifier described as a salted hash. A CSV distance matrix, intersection map and vehicle-type mapping are also listed. The public, ungated Hugging Face page hosts one ZIP archive; GitHub hosts documentation. Both pages state CC BY 4.0, so access is free. A road-network modeller could use the detections and distance matrix to calibrate link travel times or test sparse-sensor traffic simulations. This review did not download the archive, inspect rows, test the claimed anonymization or verify coordinates and camera coverage. The paper citation on GitHub remains preliminary. Related resources include road topology and traffic-count records; no exact matching catalogue record was found.
